attr.title: OMORI (PMJS)
attr.desc: OMORI, the psychological horror RPG by OMOCAT, running on PMJS, a lightweight native runtime for RPG Maker MV. Requires your own OMORI game files (Steam release 1.0.8).
attr.inst: Copy your Steam OMORI install folder into ports/omori-pmjs/gamedata/ and put the game's 32-character decryption key in gamedata/key.txt. Alternatively copy Steam's appcache/appinfo.vdf into gamedata/. The first launch converts the files and prepares a cache; allow about 25 minutes and 5.5 GB of free space.
